from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u071/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    largest_color = None
    largest_size = 0
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            size = 0
            while stack:
                rr, cc = stack.pop()
                size += 1
                for nr, nc in ((rr-1, cc), (rr+1, cc), (rr, cc-1), (rr, cc+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and (nr, nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc] == color:
                        seen.add((nr, nc))
                        stack.append((nr, nc))
            if size > largest_size:
                largest_size = size
                largest_color = color
    return [[largest_color] * 3 for _ in range(3)]
'''
p=base/'task-f39a594f.py'; p.write_text(code)
